In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.

"This lair before us is legendary in this part of the forest. Early settlers called this region of the forest as the Dragon's Forest. The dragons were many, then one day for some unknown reason most of the just vanished. Some of the Dragons stayed."

Oracle Elf 
"We have fallen! This city is no longer ours and a curse shall fall upon the owner. Our Master shall release spiders and his devoted to attack! You have made a grave mistake."

"Filthy Cyclops! These beasts will never rest. Our presence in this forest have really angered, the Cyclops and Trolls. They will never rest. Neither shall we, the Alliance will live on to fight day after day!"
"Creature Tower is a vicious place. Many of our people have died in this dreadful place. I do not know what is in there. If we do plan on going in we best be prepared to face anything."
"We must watch our steps! The forest has eyes watching us! Enemies are everywherer waiting until we are vulnerable to attack us! I sense that we are being watched as we speak!"
"I cannot shake the feeling that we are being watched! Our enemies will strike at any moment now!"

"This city was the first to fall to the Orcs and their brethren. Morgana is said to be chained in the dungeons. Let us go in there and show these vermin that the Alliance will not tolerate their treatment."

Baroness Morgana 
"Thank you for freeing me from the prison. The Orcs are determined to topple the Alliance. I was struck from behind by a Troll. I woke up only to find myself in a vile prison. We must hurry before the Orcs strengthen their numbers!"

"Here take this item. I will be ready to battle alongside you. I fear that the the assault will continue. We must be sure to protect the capital. If we should fail the Orcs will destroy the Alliance!"
"Listen, did you hear that! These forests are filled with hostile creatures. We best prepare ourselves for battle."

Elf Lord Aragon of the GFC 
"Foul, sinners! You dare enter this forest wihtout showing the proper tribute to the all mighty Elf Lord. I am the chosen one, you may have defeated Angus! You are strong, I will give you that. Next to me you are nothing!"
"A hard fought victory well done! Soon we will break the backs of the Orcs and the Trolls. Let us clear the prisons and see if any of our fallen can around!"

Baron Of New Castle 
"Oh thank you for liberating my city. I fought off my enemies for as long as I could. Eventually though they just over powered me. We must keep this city from falling. I will do my best to serve the Alliance."

Baron 
"I will serve the Alliance as long as this city remains under Alliance protection. The day that it falls to our enemies. Is the day that I reconsider my arrangement. However now my bow serves your cause and I am grateful."
"Fallen Virtue has fallen to the might of the Alliance! We have won a great battle here today and we shall reap the rewards. The Orcs and the other vile creatures have been weakened greatly!"

Forest Liege Adest Of Fallen Virtue City 
"Your great victory has released me. I give you my sword and my word that I will devote my life to the Alliance! Long live the Alliance and death to those who stand in our way!"
"There is something that is bothering me. Something just doesn't seem right! We have to watch out we are in a hostile realm!"

Adest  
"The Alliance is weak! I appear before you know as a woman with power. The Fifth Column will emerge and Galleans love for us will be matched by his rage against all our foes! Gallean is sick, weak Elves like you have made him feeble!"

Angus  
"I promise that I will do my best to see to the death of each and every member of the Alliance. I will rule over everyone! The Alliance will be destroyed by my hand!"

Baron 
"I hear the calling my master! I shall raise my bow and fight our enemies!"

Baroness 
"We have waited for you my master. I shall call upon the skies to destroy our enemies. I have heard your call, I have the voice at night! The Alliance must be destroyed!"

Dwarf King Mad Hammer 
"By Wotan's might I strike down this shrine to evil!"

Dwarf King Mad Hammer 
"You have done well! For destroying the Orc cities, I alongside the Mountain Clans shall join your cause to wipe out the evil in this realm!"

Bandit 
"This is good news! However I fear that our problems are only to get bigger. I am certain that the Legions Of The Damned will not be too pleased with this treaty! We must be prepared for the worse. Our guardian Illumiele is still weak."
Make sure that Angus is defeated. It doesn't matter who defeats him so long as he dies. Bring the Dwarf King Mad Hammer to Matusem's Altar to destroy it.

Angus 
"I can feel the unholy power flowing through me. All those who defied my calling shall burn!"

Elder One 
"We shall have peace and forgive all past actions. For us to survive we must bring Uther's blood to the alter along with the Dwarf King Mad Hammer who will only arrive once the five cities are conquered."
"Wait! I heard something. Show yourself I know that you are here. The Alliance commands that you show yourself."

Arcillen  
"How I despise the Alliance. Do you hear the calling like we do? Can you hear him calling out to spread blood across the land? I do, I can hear the calling from our master. Only you choose to deny the call! For that you cannot leave!"
"The vile creatures do not deserve to share this land with us! From past experience I know that the Legions will be back! We must keep an eye out on them!"

Dwarf King Mad Hammer 
"By the strength of Wotan I strike down upon this place of evil!"

Angus 
"I may have been defeated this time. The Legions Of The Damned have promised me eternal life. I will never rest until the Alliance is shattered. Galleans speaks to me and he wants vengeance!"

Agrothron 
"This city is ours! We are the true Elves! Nonbelievers like yourself will never hear the calling. At night our master calls us, Gallean wants blood to flow. I can hear him speak. I can hear him calling out to me! The Alliance is doomed!"

Zagamon Of The Damned 
"Angus, has told us that your guardian is weak. The time has come for the Legions to destroy the Alliance!"

Illumielle 
"The Chaos from our previous Conflict has me weakened. I cannot defend our capital alone. I need help, leave some Elves behind. If not the Capital will fall. The word of my weakened condition has been spread. The Orcs are on their way!"

Illumielle 
"We will need help! The Orcs have control over a number of cities. The three most important of these are Fallen Virtue, New Castle, and Morgana. Capture these cities and we will have weakened their attack."

Illumielle 
"I am pleased with your progress. You must hurry our enemies gather. The Mountain Clans will join our cause and the Dwarf King Mad Hammer will aid us in search of the source of evil. We need to capture the following five cities for them."

Illumielle 
"The cities that we must capture are Champions City, Fallen Virtue, Morgana City, Newcastle and Orc Realm. Once we have control of all five cities we will have an alliance with the Mountain Clans. We will need all the allies in this realm."

"Our enemies are numerous! We must use our resources carefully! We are surrounded by hostile creatures. I fear that our problems will only get bigger. Only with the aid of the Mountain Clans do we have a chance to survive!"

"Galleans Fifth Column, have returned! The GFC are determined to destroy our cause. I am tired of their claims of being able to hear some secret message from our Lord. They must be dealt with before they destroy the Alliance!"

"The Undead Hordes have been here! They have been a thorn in our side for years. The time must come when we are strong enough to destroy the Mortis and her followers. Only when the Hordes are finally defeated will there be any peace!"
"We are deeper into the forest! We must be sure that Mad Hammer is able to survive. If not our Quest is doomed. The hostile forest and the Legions Of The Damned cannot stop us from our goal!"

"Our battles have been numerous. This city Haven was named as such for a reason. Hidden away all the way down here I believe we are safe for the time being. Let us be sure that we are well rested to carry on our mission!"

"Green Forest City! This used to be the home of the GFC, the Fifth Column must never go up! The Alliance is weak enough as is. Should we survive this mission we will make it our duty to travel to all the realms and enlist as many Elves as possible!"
"We shouldn't be too far from the altar. Once there we have to make sure that we can get the Dwarf King to destroy the place!"

GFC Elves 
"Dwarf King may be small, however you are the biggest fool that I have ever seen. The Mountain Clans have always been envious of the Elves. Now you dare try to destroy us! I can hear my master calling out to me. You must die!"

Illumielle 
"There is movement in the south. The Orcs are bringing along reinforcements. They have sensed that I am weakened. Do not let them take the capital."

Forest Liege Elysium 
"Have no fear! I am not here to betray the Alliance. I am here to find and defeat my brother Angus! Sometime ago, he went mad claiming he heard the call. Angus believed that Gallean has ordered the destruction of nonbelievers!"

Forest Liege Elysium 
"I fear that if Angus is not stopped! The Alliance will be doomed. I believe that Angus is mad, however I am more concerned with the dark voice that he is hearing. I fear that it is Mortis who calls out to him if not another."

Angus must be eliminated by either the Alliance or a third party. Their must also be a treaty with the Mountain Clans. The Dwarf King Mad Hammer must survive and be brought to 'Matusem's Altar' where he will destroy the unholy shrine.

Orc 
"Fight, Elves are weak and their Guardian will soon fall!"

Illumielle 
"Never mind the simpleton's words! I must not ever be defeated! If my castle falls we have lost. Give me that item so that I may be better able to defend us!"
"Let us take take everything in here and use it to our advantage!"

Ashkael 
"Your journey shall end here my so called King! The Legions Of The Damned Shall destroy you where you stand!"

Infernal Demon  
"Eternal damnation awaits those who cross the Legions Of The Damned!"

Ashkael 
"All Elves shall burn! Envoy Angus has seen the future! An Infernal epoch is upon us! All those who fight against us shall burn to our might!"

Oracle Elf 
"The cursed blood of Uther! Gallean wants us to give this blood to the alter. Only then can we have a chance of surviving. The blood will release powerful magic that will help us find and save the Dark Elves!"
